annotations.title: Trim, reformat, caption and brand a clip

description: Runs up to 6 finishing operations in order on a clip of the library, each on the file the one before made: trim, reformat to another frame, burn in captions, overlay a brand logo, close with an end card, or mix in music. Returns the last job, whose result links the finished file. A call that runs past 4 minutes returns the job it is on and the operations still to run. Free of credits. The clip must already be in the library: upload footage at https://ugc.fans/library, then find its address with ugcfans_list_files. mix confirms the person may use the music file.

brand.description: overlay and end_card: the id of a saved brand; overlay puts its logo in the top-right corner, and end_card uses its colours and logo.

cues.description: captions: the lines to show, each with start and end seconds and its text.

end.description: trim: where to stop, in seconds.

mode.description: reformat: crop the picture, pad it, or follow the subject (default crop).

music.description: mix: the address of the music file, out/..., which the person has the right to use.

start.description: trim: where to start, in seconds (default 0).

transcript.description: captions: the id of a transcript from ugcfans_transcribe.

source.description: The clip's address in the library, out/...
